name: zinterp_context_eval_condition_expr
description: zInterp_Context::EvalConditionExpr evaluates tokenized macro conditions left-to-right using || and && operators.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.

Binary Ninja renders dynamic tokenList indexing as byte-offset pointer arithmetic and normalizes the two-token boolean return through neg/sbb/neg; assembly review confirms the functional token evaluator.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c1b50 validates tokenCount handling, tokenList[1] single-term evaluation, left-to-right application of || and && via IsMacroTrue, and stopping on an unrecognized operator.
The native smoke verifies empty expression, single-term expression, left-to-right mixed operator behavior, and malformed-operator stopping.
